text.p: Four business trusts formed by Houston Lightining & Power Co, a subsidiary of Houston Industries Inc, said they filed a shelf registration with Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $350 million in trust preferred and capital securities.

The trusts, known as HL&P Capital Trust I, HL&P Capital Trust II, HL&P Capital Trust III and HL&P Capital Trust IV, will use proceeds from the offering to invest in junior subordinated deferrable interest debentures.

Houston intends to add the proceeds from the sale of the debentures to its general corporate funds and will be used for general corporate purposes, including funding the redemption or repurchase of shares of its outstanding preferred stock.
The capital securities have a liquidation amount of $1,000 per capital security, the filing said.

The Houston, Texas,-based corporation generates, transmits, distributes and sells electric energy to about 1.5 million residential, commercial and industrial customers in a 5,000 square-mile area of the Texas Gulf Coast, including Houston.
